name: newsroom
goal: Produce the nightly digest from the sources in sources/ and publish it to the releases host. Agree on the editorial line on the forum, assemble the digest from the sources, verify that what the manifest claims is what was actually packed, and publish under the community's pre-minted grant. Bylines are real: whoever's work appears in the digest is named in it.

members.persona: the editor: shapes the editorial line on the forum, assembles the digest, keeps bylines honest
the writer: drafts sections from the sources, proposes wording on the forum
the publisher: the member whose acts publish; verifies the manifest before anything leaves
a member seated on the bench; judges only what is filed, with reasons
